summary: The surface of the Earth keeps changing over time through climates such as, floods, volcanic eruptions, and earthquakes. The mission of Dorm's Spaces is to build a website that shows how earth has been impacted through out the decades from (1950-2025). The website uses SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) to document how Earth is effected by different climates whether it is caused by humans or nature causes. For example, volcanic activities, deforestation, wildfires, and urbanization. the benefits of this website helps people document how the Earth has been affected and help people be aware of such sudden climate changes in the future. To make this possible certain programming languages have been used to integrate this software, such as GoLang, React + TypeScript. NASA data sources were used to give the software information and satellite photos and data that is necessary to process and display them to achieve the wanted results.
details: Dorm's Space uses SAR to integrate images from space that allows documentation of the Earth possible. This can be beneficial to help limit climate changes such as, wildfires, disruption of farms, and land clearing and others. The main aim of this project is to show how the world has changes through the drastic changes that happened to the world over the decades. The tools that makes this software possible is GoLang, React + TypeScript. This website uses the NASA Data Portal and organizes it into simple user friendly data that anyone can easily access and understand. The main factor that were considered: easy user experience, fast performance, and optimized processing.
